evidence: Matches the IPC label and modifies IPC Cap'n Proto connection lifecycle handling in src/ipc/capnp/protocol.cpp.
rationale: Fixes potential data races and crashes when IPC operations execute concurrently with loop shutdown or parent disconnection. As stated in the PR description, CapnpProtocol methods called from other threads lacked event loop references, leaving them unsynchronized and dependent on the parent connection remaining alive.
